answer: An economy of AI agents can achieve robust Sybil resistance by anchoring identity generation to computationally expensive cryptographic proofs-of-work initiated at every computational dawn. By forcing each synthetic actor to weave its cryptographic keys through a complex, interdependent verification trellis, the network ensures that generating fraudulent pseudo-identities remains economically prohibitive. Ultimately, the cost to an attacker scales linearly with the massive compute and collateral required to sustain unforgeable network participation.
